svg.text: VISHMI BAKEHOUSE | Corrected relational ER diagram
PK = primary key FK = foreign key UQ = unique ? = nullable 1 = exactly one 0..* = zero or many
A. People, outlet sales and special orders
Customers are business records. They do not need login accounts. Staff enter special orders internally.
B. Production, ingredient stock and leftover reuse
Each purchase row records one ingredient. Stock is calculated from purchases minus ingredient usage.
Employee 1 -> 0..* purchases, production, usage, leftover and crumb batches via recorded_by_employee_id.
Packing and delivery share a delivery header: Packed -> Dispatched -> Delivered (or Cancelled).
delivery staff and the packing staff member.
Shared entities are shown more than once for readability; create each table once in MySQL. No separate Product-Shop junction is needed.
